title: ConversionUnit
description: One unit of the source document: a PDF page, a slide, a sheet, or the whole file. Engines report one unit per page, slide or sheet; word-processing files and other formats without a page model have one unit of kind `file`. The `$defs` of this file also hold the shared code grammars: method codes and warning codes.
$comment: No `title` field: a unit title is document text. Adapters MUST drop it, and it MUST NOT be logged or stored. Unknown fields are rejected.

number.description: Page, slide or sheet number, counted from 1. `null` for a unit of kind `file`.

chars.description: Number of Unicode code points of the source text extracted for this unit. Counted: the text of its paragraphs, headings, list items, table cells, speaker-note paragraphs and footnote and endnote bodies, plus the slide title. Not counted: page anchors; the generated part of slide and sheet headings (`## Slide N`, the `. ` before a slide title, and the whole sheet heading line with the sheet name); hidden suffixes and every other marker (figure markers with their captions, the speaker-notes label line, `[^n]` references and labels, hidden row and column suffixes); placeholders and notes an engine adds for unread or recognised content; Markdown markup. The rules only test whether every unit has `chars` = 0, so engines MAY count approximately, but `chars` MUST be 0 when the unit has no extracted source text and MUST be greater than 0 when it has some. DC reports its own count of the unit's text without "not recognised" placeholders.

images.description: Pictures found in this unit, kept or not.

hidden.description: `true` when the slide or sheet is hidden in the source. Absent means "not reported". Never `true` for a page or a file.

warnings.description: Warning codes of this unit. Result-level warnings are not repeated here.

UnitKind.description: What the unit is. The DC kind `document` is an alias of `file`; adapters map it.

SnakeCode.description: A snake_case code: the grammar of engine failure codes and method codes.

Method.description: How the unit reached the text. A registered code (`RegisteredMethod`) or another snake_case value, which the core treats as text extracted without recognition. The empty string means "not reported" and is also treated as non-recognition. The only rule that reads this field is membership in `RecognitionSet`.

RegisteredMethod.description: Registered method codes. New codes are added by a minor version.

oneOf.description: Text taken from the PDF text layer. Not recognition.
Text taken from the structure of an office document (OOXML, including legacy formats converted to OOXML first). Not recognition.
Page or slide recognised by a local OCR engine. Recognition (planned: not in today's recognition set).
Page or slide recognised by a model. Recognition (planned: not in today's recognition set).
Recognition was needed but no recogniser is configured or available. Recognition.
Recognition was attempted and failed. Recognition.
Recognition was requested but did not finish within the engine's budget. Recognition.

RecognitionSet.description: Method values that count as recognition: any of them adds the unit to `ocr_units`, makes extraction `partial` and adds `ocr` to `agent_file_why`. The set is the five recognition codes of `RegisteredMethod` plus the DC alias `ocr`. Planned: today the set is DC's `ocr`, `ocr_failed`, `ocr_unavailable` and `ocr_pending`; `ocr_local` and `ocr_model` join it with the shared outcome rules.

WarningCode.description: A warning code: a snake_case name with an optional `:detail`. Consumers MUST keep unknown codes and MUST ignore them.

RegisteredWarning.description: Warning codes with an effect in the outcome rules, plus informational codes known today. Any other code that matches `WarningCode` is stored and has no effect. A `const` entry matches only exactly and MUST be emitted without a `:detail`; a `pattern` entry matches by its `name:` prefix and MUST carry a non-empty detail. Otherwise the code has no effect.

oneOf.description: No recogniser is configured. Recognition flag: extraction `partial`, `agent_file_why` gets `ocr`.
Recognition ran and found no text. Recognition flag.
`ocr_failed:<detail>`: recognition failed on a page (detail: error name). Recognition flag, and one recognition rerun later.
`picture_format_skipped:<ext>`: a picture in an unsupported format was skipped. `agent_file_why` gets `pictures_skipped`.
`unsupported_media_type:<type>`: a picture was not kept. `agent_file_why` gets `pictures_skipped`.
The picture limit was reached. `agent_file_why` gets `pictures_skipped`.
Macros, scripts or actions were ignored. `agent_file_why` gets `active_content`.
A table in the text was cut at the engine's limit (any number of tables). `agent_file_why` gets `table_truncated`; extraction is not changed.
The PDF text layer is unreliable (for example fonts without a Unicode map). Planned (not current): extraction `partial`, `agent_file_why` gets `broken_text_layer`. Today the code is only stored.
Informational; its meaning is not defined by this contract. Stored only.
Informational; its meaning is not defined by this contract. Stored only.
`content_not_read:<kind>`: DC did not read a part of the document. Informational, stored only.
